Direction from Jack Heart (2026-11-27) to break the MTG-497 <-> EXP-77 deadlock:
1. Do NOT write a throwaway Manabot adapter. `MTG-497` (`~/src/manabot.mtg-497-support-gpu-batched`, branch `jack/mtg-497-support-gpu-batched-policy-evaluation-for-large`) has been steered to finish its MLX pass and wire/commit the real Etude `play_many` + `async def play` Manabot adapter against this `EXP-77` checkout without waiting for PyPI.
2. You will be resumed automatically as soon as `MTG-497` finishes committing its `play_many` adapter. At that point, run Pass 3 (Gate 2) on one CUDA GPU (RTX 4090 or L4, within Jack Heart's approved $15 total cap and <=30m per rental round):
   - Compare `main` sync vs `EXP-77` (`play_many` socket) — and `6db832` (`play_many` local zero-copy) if clean — on the 32-deal / 128-game `w160l8` and `w384l8` panel.
   - Record games/hr, rows/forward, GPU busy %, and `batches.json` stage timings.
   - Use the measurements to set `max_batch` and sizing defaults in `etude`, then proceed through review/QA/pr-publish to `ship-review`.
